shortMobileNavigation.tests: 320x480 expanded menu reaches Contact using Tab; no-JS header scrolls out of the way and main content remains reachable.

form.tests: Native required/email/group/ack validation; keyboard submission and focus; processing/duplicate guard; retained inputs; mocked HTTP 400/429/500; all field serialization; acknowledged success focus. No live requests.
